high_level_description: The image is a photograph of a printed text on a white background. The text is a quote attributed to Steve Jobs, written in black font. The quote discusses the idea that life can be broader than what one might initially think, emphasizing the ability to change and influence one's environment. It suggests that once someone understands they can "poke life" and make changes, they will want to do so, leading to a desire to improve their surroundings.
